summary: Validated new Reporte Maestro v2 features (4 cover layouts + conclusions section + custom_intro/custom_conclusions + preview PNG endpoint). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass against the public URL. Frontend: all tabs, 8 style buttons, 4 layout buttons, 9 institutional inputs, custom narrative textareas and conclusions toggle present with correct data-testid; preview POST returns 200 image/png and the PNG renders inside mr-preview-canvas (natural size 1588x2246 → 2x device scale from A4 794x1123). End-to-end flow APA layout + institutional fields + preview works.
action_items: Outdated legacy test file /app/backend/tests/test_master_report.py still targets the old 5-style API (apa/michigan/...) and 8 sections groups; it will error now that styles are olimpico/atleta/... and there are 9 groups. Main agent should delete or migrate it to avoid future CI noise. Not blocking — testing agent created a dedicated test_master_report_v2.py that covers the new surface (styles list was already re-tested elsewhere).
critical_code_review_comments: master_report.py is ~1100 lines; consider splitting: models + styles dict + html_builder + routes. Works correctly but getting hard to maintain.
sections-catalog returns 9 groups now; the old test_master_report.py hard-codes 'len(groups)==8' and ids without 'closing' — will fail. Recommend removing that stale file.
_render_preview_png launches a fresh Chromium per preview call (~3s overhead). For heavier usage consider a Playwright pool, but acceptable for MVP.
custom_intro/custom_conclusions are rendered via _esc + split('\n\n'), which safely escapes HTML but also escapes user markdown. Acceptable; documented behaviour.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_master_report_v2.py (new — 15 tests for cover-layouts, closing group, preview PNG for 4 layouts, generate with custom_intro/custom_conclusions/apa/all layouts)
seed_data_creation: none; uses existing plans of test user
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires clicking 'Iniciar Sesión' on landing (redirects to /auth), not /login. Master Report modal opens from data-testid='header-master-report-btn' in top bar. Preview endpoint responds ~3-5s; PNG ~50-300KB. PDF generate ~5-15s. Legacy test_master_report.py should be removed or rewritten (it still references removed APA/Michigan styles).
rca of the issue: n/a — no issues found; all new T10 features operate end-to-end.
